feature: MOVE / ADD / SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING (roadmap unit 41, stage 1)
oracle: GnuCOBOL 3.1.2.0 (gnucobol-ocesql image) vs generated Java, standard output compared byte for byte

runs.note: held out: never run during development

supported_and_proven: MOVE / ADD / SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING (and CORR) between two group items on a single line
pairing by name and by qualification below the two groups, in source order
overlapping names, nested subgroups of the same name, different sizes and kinds (alphanumeric, unsigned, signed, decimal)
names present in one group only, and names at a different level in the other (do not correspond)
ADD / SUBTRACT use the numeric pairs only
refused_by_name_not_lowered: a statement wrapped over several lines
a statement nested inside another statement (for example inside IF)
an operand that is not a group
a name that is a group in one operand and elementary in the other
unverified: behaviour on IBM Enterprise COBOL (no IBM evidence exists)
FILLER and 88-level interaction beyond what the generator produces
groups more than three levels deep; more than three groups per program
COMP / COMP-3 / edited items as CORRESPONDING members (generator uses display items only)
log_files: development machine scratch logs; per-program output hashes were not recorded for this sweep
